projects.title: SERT — Social Engineering Red Teaming
projects.blurb: An AI agent orchestration workflow that runs phishing-style social-engineering attacks against company employees and AI agents, exposing vulnerabilities before real attackers can exploit them.
points: Orchestrator agent summarizes every attack and compiles a report: most successful phishing methods, most vulnerable employees, and recommended improvements.
Lets companies find weak links in their teams and stress-test AI agents with dangerous capabilities.
Built solo at VS Live — Microsoft AI Hackathon 2026.
projects.award: 2nd place, Best AI Agent or Workflow Automation — $1,250

projects.title: Skill Mutator
projects.blurb: Evolves LLM skills by driving a skill evaluator as a tool: parallel edits → combine → critic → evaluate → keep or dump, gated by held-out generalization. Accuracy, token usage, and step count act as the fitness signal.
points: Built during LLM skill mutation research with Prof. Anant Sahai (UC Berkeley).
Optimized skills across benchmarks covering code editing, SQL, data science, and logic puzzles.

projects.title: Reodite — Student Success Tools
projects.blurb: General student success tools, all in one platform: course lookup, prerequisite tree visualizations, a drag-and-drop planner for building multi-year schedules that respect prerequisite rules and program requirements, and schedule sharing for whole friend groups. Started as UBC academic tools and keeps covering more ground.
points: Grew out of Reogent — a spatially-aware campus AI ideated at the UBC CIC × AWS Hackathon — merged with ReoditeTools; the tools stayed, the chatbot was dropped.
ScheduleSharer folded in: overlays everyone's schedules into one master weekly calendar so friend groups can actually find time to meet.
Backed by unified scraped datasets: courses, grades, tuition, building and walking GeoJSON, and study spaces.

projects.title: Balancing Biped
projects.blurb: A technical demo of realistic physics-based balancing bipedal creatures. They stand on moving ground, balance with weights stacked on top, and shrug off projectiles.
points: Authored an LLM skill that automates creating highly tuned balancing creatures of different physiques.

projects.title: Stuck at Sea — Computer Vision Game
projects.blurb: A first-person shooter controlled entirely through webcam hand tracking — positional tracking plus custom hand-sign detection built on MediaPipe. Also lives on the games side of this site.

projects.title: Chess With Voice Chat
projects.blurb: Chess, but you can trash-talk: a chess app with built-in voice chat.

games.title: Birb
games.blurb: Platformer meets tower defense — lead enemies into cages and bullet lines while stopping bombers from destroying your power sources. Survive to round 20, with bonus rounds up to 30.
points: Built with a team of four for GMTK Game Jam 2026 (theme: Count Down): design & programming with GoatDog, art by Rob, music & sound by Tony Andriamanana.
Playable in the browser — the web version folds in post-jam feedback.

games.title: Biped Balancer
games.blurb: Browser demo of the Balancing Biped project — 2D physics creatures that stay upright on moving ground, under stacked weights, and through projectile hits.

games.title: Stuck at Sea
games.blurb: A first-person shooter you play with your hands — literally. Open your hand to aim, close your fist to shoot, open it again to reload, all through webcam hand tracking built on MediaPipe.
games.jam: Illinois State University Winter Game Jam

games.title: Duality
games.blurb: A 3D puzzle platformer shooter where health and energy are one resource — every jump, shot, and puzzle solve comes at a cost. Dodge deadly lasers, leap between towering platforms, and outsmart relentless enemies.
points: Built solo in 72 hours for Mini Jam 187 (theme: Duality).

games.title: Blox
games.blurb: 2D physics-based base builder — protect your people from enemies and their projectiles. Playable in the browser.

games.title: Blub
games.blurb: Top-down underwater cave explorer — survive procedurally generated caves by finding air bubbles to refill your oxygen while fending off hostile creatures.

games.title: Two Toy Tanks
games.blurb: Local split-screen tank duel on randomly generated maps — three classes (Spammer, Surfer, Miner), powerups, first hit wins. Made in 12 hours for a high school game dev club tournament.
games.jam: High School Game Dev Club Tournament

games.title: Blob
games.blurb: Defend a forest island as Bob the Blob — absorb defeated slimes to grow, because your health is your mass. Made by four high schoolers in 96 hours for GMTK Game Jam 2024 (theme: Built to Scale).

games.title: Blind Arcade
games.blurb: An accessibility-first mobile arcade for the blind and visually impaired — games that need no visuals at all, built on gyroscope motion tracking, spatial audio, and haptic feedback.
points: Three arcade games: an endless runner, a first-person shooter, and a coin collector.
Published on the Google Play Store — nearly 3k downloads and over 10k views on YouTube.

games.title: EcoGrav
games.blurb: Physics puzzler — guide a plastic bottle into the trashcan by bending gravity. Made in 58 hours for Mini Jame Gam #32 (theme: Gravity).

games.title: Wump is Watching
games.blurb: Stealth dungeon crawler remake of Hunt the Wumpus — the monster hears you and hunts by the noise you make. Built over multiple weeks for the Microsoft Hunt the Wumpus competition.

games.title: Flying Froggo
games.blurb: Fast-paced endless scroller where Frogger meets grapple hooks — swing from tree to tree ahead of an approaching tornado. Mobile remake of Grapple Phroggo, currently in beta.

games.title: Checkpoint
games.blurb: Top-down bullet-hell where your weapons are PC parts — fire disks and power supplies, swing your mouse, and spend one energy pool on shots, upgrades, and teleports back to spawn. Made in 58 hours for Mini Jame Gam #27 (theme: Back to the Beginning).

games.title: The Hunted
games.blurb: A top-down shooter/horror where roles reverse: build a mob to hunt a monster, then play as both the monster and a mob member — balanced so skill (and a little luck) can win on either side.

games.title: Grapple Phroggo
games.blurb: Gravity is skewed! Use your frog tongue to swing yourself up and away from the constantly rising lava — Frogger meets grapple hooks.

games.title: Snake but a Tower Defense
games.blurb: Snake crossed with tower defense — collect turrets with varied attack patterns and coil them into a living wall of defense. Built in 18 hours on a plane flight.

games.title: Recoil Boi
games.blurb: A Flappy-Bird-style scroller where your only movement is gun recoil. Built in 11 hours on a plane flight.

games.title: Trii Tanks
games.blurb: Wii Tanks reimagined — a 3D roguelike bullet-hell proof of concept, playable in the browser. Trii Tanks 2.0 is in the works.

games.title: MIE
games.blurb: Top-down shooter dungeon crawler where HP and ammo are the same variable — every shot is a gamble.

games.title: Tetrimania
games.blurb: TETRIS… but a PLATFORMER — dodge the falling blocks by jumping on them while steering the pieces to clear rows and rack up points.

experience.title: LLM Skill Mutation Research
experience.org: with Prof. Anant Sahai · UC Berkeley
points: Developed an agent orchestration workflow that optimizes skills on LLM benchmarks.
Created a deterministic skill evaluation method using accuracy, token usage, and step count as metrics — fed back to the mutator as a fitness signal for deciding which skills to keep.
Optimized skills across benchmarks covering code editing, SQL, data science, and logic puzzles.
